aggregateEventStudies.note: FC3 pooled event studies: shared-convention check, recomputed AAR/CAAR/tests over the pooled events

alignEventWindows.note: FC3 alignment helper: the ONE anchoring code path exposed alone — anchor date + resolved window rows or the exclusion reason

CANONICAL_FACTOR_RECIPES.note: FC3 the seven canonical recipe families — versioned artifacts carrying the not-universal-truth disclosure

compareResearchRuns.note: Stage 4.5 slice 5 (2026-09-03): typed deltas of two runs of one kind — identity, membership, rank moves, score deltas, exclusion reasons, coefficients, abnormal returns per offset, per-quantile/horizon values, hygiene verdict, and the structural run diff

compositeFactorScore.note: FC3 weighted composite of standardized vectors, direction-signed, weights normalized+echoed

eligibleObservationsAt.note: Stage 4.6 slice 1 (FC8, 2026-09-03): the observations a decision at asOf may see — availability at or before the cutoff (an explicit session lag through the caller’s session index), the latest version per instrument, universe members only when a history is given; the same law the screening verbs apply

eventStudy.note: FC3 event study: session-anchored windows, four expected-return models, AR/CAR/AAR/CAAR with cross-sectional tests, overlap policy explicit

factorDecay.note: FC3 rank IC per stated horizon — the signal decay curve

factorSpreadReturn.note: FC3 top-minus-bottom quantile forward return, equal-weighted legs

factorTurnover.note: FC3 per-quantile membership turnover between formations

formQuantilePortfolios.note: FC3 quantile formation: exact partition of the valued entries, sizing disclosed

informationCoefficient.note: FC3 IC: Pearson + Spearman over paired instruments, null-with-reason below three pairs

neutralizeFactor.note: FC3 neutralization: group demeaning + OLS projection removal, residuals orthogonal by construction

rankUniverse.note: FC3 rank: one declared numeric field, explicit tie policy, stable

readResearchRun.note: Stage 4.5 slice 5 (2026-09-03): Gate B read door + foreign-type refusal + the run-level migration policy under research.run:<kind> (core applyReportMigrations) + report re-validation

replayResearchRun.note: Stage 4.5 slice 5 (2026-09-03): re-issue the run's direct operation from the stored input (referenced rows hash-verified) and compare canonical bytes; a run that recorded a caller callback refuses by name

requireDefinitionsMap.note: FC3 guard-of-guards: the definitions Map every declaration-aware guard consumes, typed

requireFieldDefinitions.note: FC3 vendor-adapter guard: declared research fields (kind + unit), keyed for the grammar checks

requireMarketEvent.note: FC3 vendor-adapter guard: the frozen MarketEvent contract

requireReturnObservations.note: FC3 vendor-adapter guard: per-session return rows, failing row named

requireScreenFilter.note: FC3 grammar guard: the closed recursive filter union against the declarations (unit-incompatible comparisons teach)

requireUniverseHistory.note: Stage 4.6 slice 1 (FC8, 2026-09-03): the universe-history guard in the (functionName, label, value) order

requireUniverseObservation.note: FC3 vendor-adapter guard: one universe row against the declarations (unknown field teaches)

requireUniverseObservations.note: FC3 vendor-adapter guard: an observation array, failing row named

RESEARCH_RUN_ARTIFACT_TYPE.note: Stage 4.5 slice 5 (2026-09-03): the artifactType every research-run artifact carries ('research.run')

RESEARCH_RUN_KINDS.note: Stage 4.5 slice 5 (2026-09-03): the frozen, data-only descriptor per run kind — operation, bulk row-set patterns, callback fields, cost class

researchRunArtifact.note: Stage 4.5 slice 5 (2026-09-03): describe a direct FC3 operation's result verbatim with the input that reproduces it (rows embedded or referenced by content-hashed handle, callbacks recorded and omitted, hygiene block and recipe verbatim) and save it as an identified artifact

scoreUniverse.note: FC3 composite score over standardized declared fields, explicit missing policy

screenUniverse.note: FC3 point-in-time screen: closed grammar, stable ordering, honest exclusion ledger

standardizeFactor.note: FC3 standardization: z-score or average-rank percentile, moments echoed

universeMembershipAt.note: Stage 4.6 slice 1 (FC8, 2026-09-03): members of a universe history at an instant (half-open intervals) and, against a previous instant, the additions and exits with reason and delisting return

winsorizeFactor.note: FC3 winsorization: classic order-statistic replacement (exactly idempotent), bounds echoed
